steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Five, four, three, two, one...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: There's the bell! Let's go!

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkh!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Marcille, on your left!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hup!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Laios, front! Right!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hup! Hah!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Senshi, behind you! Left! Forward!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Hooh! Hyah—

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Front back front right left left right!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Eyah—

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Front back left front right left back!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: HIYAH—!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: *huff*... *huff*... That's all the ink spirits over here handled...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Much appreciated.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Oh, don't mention it! We're happy to help with any of your troubles, considering the village agreed to take us in for a bit.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I'll be off then. Promised to help plant some veggies out in the fields.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Senshi sure has gotten friendly with the locals.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Is it not the same for you, Chilchuck? Uncle Zhang told me to invite you over for a drink with him after you finished with the ink spirits.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: He just doesn't want to admit he can't outdrink me.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: May I come over for some tea today, Dawn?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Certainly, I am available if you are.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: It's your turn to tell tales of your adventures, and I am quite looking forward to them.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Though... I do recall that when you first arrived, you mentioned that you had to save Laios's sister.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Are you sure you are alright with staying here?

spans.text: you are alright with staying here?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: It's true that our goal is to save Falin.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: It's not like rushing will help us find a way to leave faster.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: And I have to admit, life is good here.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: We'll talk it over when the time comes. Right, Laios?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hmm? Sorry, what did you say?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I can't believe you weren't listening to me again!

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: *chuckle* Your passion for ink spirits is well-known across the village by now, Laios.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I mean, these 'ink spirit' slimes are just so interesting!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: They have fixed forms with distinct heads, bodies, and limbs! Instead of enveloping their prey's heads, they attack like other beasts! They even vocalize!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: But the strangest part is how, unlike other monsters, they don't leave behind any kind of corpse, just some black water.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I told the villagers all about their weaknesses yesterday, but they didn't seem very excited.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: That's because you're the only person who cares about that sort of stuff.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: ...Huh, is that so?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: But even Chilchuck's learned to exploit those weaknesses. The villagers can't seem to grasp them at all. Every time I see them facing ink spirits, it's like they have no idea what they're doing.

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkh-gkh!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I'm starting to suspect they can even understand us...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: It's odd. Senshi said they're not like slimes at all. Slimes have distinct organs, after all...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Alright, alright, I get it.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hmm? Did some of them slip through?

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Hraaagh—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hmm? That one looked a bit familiar... It's got a mole on its face. Where have I seen that before?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I'm pretty sure I killed the exact same one a few days ago. Why's it shown up again?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: What's going on here? ...Wait, could it have come back from the dead? I'm going to go get a better look!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Remember to be back for dinner!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...*sigh* And he's not listening. As usual.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Sorry he's like that.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Oh, it's fine.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Anyway, do you still remember how long it's been since you arrived at P'o-shan Village?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Of course I...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: How long has it been since we arrived?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Wait, wait wait wait... There's way WAY too many of you.

steps.name: Ink Spirits
steps.text: Gkh...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: We might not have been here long, but we've been killing plenty of ink spirits every day. Who would've thought there'd still be this many left?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: There are so many of them here, yet there's no sign of fighting... Could they actually coexist peacefully?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I don't see any of their young, though.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Now that I think about it, I can't tell their genders, either. They're all adults too, no young or old. No matter how you look at it, it's no ordinary monster cluster.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hmm? Wait, where'd the familiar-looking one go?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Crap, that one spotted me!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I've got to think of a way to stop it from calling over more! I can't take them all on my own—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Oh no, it's about to call out—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Here, have some fruit!

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkh...haaa? Munch munch...

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Munch munch...

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkh.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: What's that, you want more?

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkh, gkh.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: As long as you don't start shouting.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Here, I was saving them as a snack, but... Look, just eat quietly, and come over when you're done. Then we can go around the back of this wall and...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: You're awfully well-behaved. What's going on here?

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: (Sneakily climbs behind the wall)

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: (Ready to pounce at apricots on the ground)

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: (Apricots pounced! Proceeds to gobble up apricots)

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: It just attacked the village, but now it's docile over a few pieces of fruit?

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: (Nom nom nom)

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: (Bites onto Laios's pocket)

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hmm? What're you up to now?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: You attack the village, yet you don’t seem any happier when you win, and you flee when you lose. Now you're just snacking on apricots!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: You do fight over food, but it makes no sense to attack the village for it—there are way more fruits in the mountains. So why attack so often just for a few fruits?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: The villagers haven’t stolen your young or encroached on your territories, so where's all this hostility coming from?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Wait, isn't that the one with the mole from earlier?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Take this!
Laios sends an apricot flying at the familiar-looking ink spirit, striking it right in the head with a 'pok!'
It staggers from the blow, but quickly recovers and raises its stubby arms to cover its head.
But that's when the sweet scent of apricot hits it.

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Hruuh!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Wait, are you here to eat apricots too?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Here, catch.

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Hruuh! Hruuh!

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Munch munch...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Let me have a closer look... Same mole, slightly bigger head than the rest, a slender yet forked tail...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: You really are the same ink spirit as last time! I thought you were rather odd, what with your belly so full you could barely walk. Hardly a ferocious marauder!

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Hruuuh...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Did you really come back to life?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Do you go through the cycle of life and death over and over?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: If so, that's pretty similar to our life in the dungeon.

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkhuu?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I still don't get it, though. If that's the case, then why attack the village in the first place?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Is it just to eat apricots?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Alright. This is the last of them...
